contract: For all valid tensor values and A zero points admitted by the original ONNX MatMulInteger graph, any output with a fixed B initializer equal elementwise to its scalar B zero point is exactly the int32 zero tensor.

rewrites.reason: All centered B weights are exactly zero

side_conditions: ONNX standard opset 15–25, single closed graph, no external data or control flow
MatMulInteger has no attributes and uses fixed 2D int8/uint8 A and B
B and its optional scalar B zero point are signedness-compatible initializers
All B entries equal B zero point, so every exact integer product is zero
Original output shape is static and contains at most 16384 int32 elements
Every untouched node, model field and interface is byte-preserved
